table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	RowID,
	Date,
	RegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = Echo.PatientCode),
	PatientName = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = Echo.PatientCode),
	FHName = (SELECT P.FName FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = Echo.PatientCode),
	Age = (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeYears))) + ' yrs ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeMonths))) + ' mon ' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(P.AgeDays))) + ' days ' FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = Echo.PatientCode),
	Gender = (SELECT P.Gender FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = Echo.PatientCode),
	PatientCode,
	AdmissionCode,
	UserCode,
	AttendingDoctCode,
	Echo,
	DateEcho,
	DoctorEcho ,
	InstitutionEcho,
	NormalLV,
	DilatedLV,
	DialatedLVValue,
	DialatedRVValue,
	DialatedLAValue,
	DialatedRAValue,
	DialatedARValue,
	LVSystolicdysfunctionEcho,
	LVSystolicdysfunctionValueEcho,
	SWMAEcho,
	SWMAValueEcho,
	EF,
	EFEcho,
	RV,
	RVsystolicdysfunctionEcho,
	RVSystolicDysfunctionValueecho,
	DiastolicDysfunctionecho,
	DiastolicDysfunctionValueecho,
	ValvularHeartDiseaseEcho,
	MS,
	MSEcho,
	MR,
	MREcho,
	AR,
	AREcho,
	ASE,
	ASEcho,
	PS,
	PSEcho,
	TR,
	TREcho,
	ASD,
	ASDEcho,
	VSD,
	VSDEcho,
	TOF,
	TOFEcho,
	PulmonaryHypertension,
	PulmonaryHypertensionEcho,
	OtherEchoDetail
FROM
	Echo
WHERE 
	Echo.AdmissionCode = :ai_code
ORDER BY 
	Echo.PatientCode,
	Echo.RowID DESC
